title: Beginnings — Mens Sana in Corpore Sano
context_prefix: Hall of Fame opening panel. Introduces the founder before Comtrade existed: Veselin (Vesa) Jevrosimovic as a young athlete.
spoken: Our story starts not with a computer, but with an athlete. Veselin Jevrosimovic, known to everyone as Vesa, was a pole-vaulter and champion of the former Yugoslav University League, competing for Red Star. At eighteen, his results earned him a full athletic scholarship to study in the United States.
detail: Veselin Jevrosimovic was a champion of the former Yugoslav University League and a member of the Red Star athletic team. Thanks to his athletic achievements, at age 18 he earned a full athletic scholarship to study in the United States. The motto Mens sana in corpore sano — a sound mind in a sound body — frames the founder's origins.
source_text: Champion of the former Yugoslav University League and member of the Red Star athletic team. Thanks to his achievements, 18-year-old Veselin Jevrosimovic earns a full athletic scholarship to study in the United States.

title: First Sparks
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: the founder discovers the emerging IT industry while studying in the US.
spoken: It was during his studies in the United States that Vesa saw where the future was heading. He discovered the potential of the emerging IT industry, built his first business connections, and met people who would become tomorrow's tech leaders.
detail: During his studies in the U.S., Veselin discovered the potential of the emerging IT industry, building his first business connections and meeting future tech leaders. This period set the direction for everything that followed.
source_text: During his studies in the U.S., Veselin discovers the potential of the emerging IT industry — building his first business connections and meeting future tech leaders.

title: CHS Electronics — A Global Venture
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: before founding Comtrade, the founder became a shareholder in CHS Electronics, then the world's second-largest computer distributor.
spoken: Together with his longtime friend Alexis Lope-Bello, Vesa became a shareholder of CHS Electronics — at the time the second-largest computer distributor in the world, with annual revenue of twelve billion dollars. He had already proven himself on the global stage.
detail: Together with his longtime friend Alexis Lope-Bello, Veselin became a shareholder of CHS Electronics — then the world's second-largest computer distributor, with annual revenue of $12 billion. He was also owner of a company in Germany. On one side stood the world, where he had proven himself; on the other, the country where he was born, which needed help toward an information-technology future.
source_text: Together with his longtime friend Alexis Lope-Bello, Veselin becomes a shareholder of CHS Electronics — then the world's second-largest computer distributor, with annual revenue of $12 billion.

title: Bringing Business Back to Belgrade
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: the founding of Comtrade in Belgrade in 1991, during a very difficult period for the country.
spoken: On the twenty-third of May, nineteen ninety-one, Comtrad Yugoslavia was founded — a bold decision to build a technology company in a country going through its most difficult times. The name came from the English words for computer and trade. And so it began.
detail: On May 23, 1991, Comtrad YU was founded — a bold step to build a tech company in a country going through its most difficult times. The name was derived from the English words for computer and trade. The first offices were in apartment A303, and later B39, in the prestigious Genex apartments in New Belgrade — home to the company for its first ten years.
source_text: On May 23, 1991 Comtrad YU was founded - a bold step to build a tech company in country that was going through its most difficult times.

title: The TV Commercial That Changed Everything
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: the 1992 television campaign that made Comtrade a household name.
spoken: In nineteen ninety-two, Comtrade became a household name thanks to a historic television campaign. It ended with a line people still remember: with our computers, your work becomes fun.
detail: In 1992, Comtrade became a household name thanks to a historic television campaign. The commercial closed with the narrator's line, roughly: 'with our computers, your work becomes fun.' Thirty years later, the company points to this campaign as a milestone in building IT awareness across the region.
source_text: In 1992, Comtrade becomes a household name thanks to a historic television campaign.
visual: to be solved using a screen

title: New Identity — CT Computers Is Born
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: the 1997 rename to CT Computers, marking a new chapter of growth.
spoken: In nineteen ninety-seven the company adopted a new name — CT Computers — marking a new chapter in its growth.
detail: 1997 — the company adopts the new name CT Computers, marking a new chapter in growth.
source_text: 1997 — the company adopts a new name, marking a new chapter in growth.

title: Crossing Borders
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: regional expansion across former-Yugoslav markets and Bulgaria between 1999 and 2001.
spoken: Regional expansion began in February nineteen ninety-nine with a company in Sarajevo — first called NTCHS, later CT Computers Sarajevo. That same year came TradeCom in Podgorica, then Skopje in two thousand, and in two thousand one the acquisition of the Bulgarian company Ekus.
detail: In February 1999 a company opened in Sarajevo — first NTCHS, later CT Computers Sarajevo — the start of regional expansion. Later in 1999, TradeCom MN opened in Podgorica, Montenegro. In February 2000 Comtrade opened in Skopje, North Macedonia. In 2001 Comtrade acquired the Bulgarian company Ekus, strengthening its presence in Southeast Europe. Regional presence rebuilt business ties that politics and conflict had severed.
source_text: In February 1999, a company opens in Sarajevo — first called NTCHS, later CT Computers Sarajevo. Later that year, TradeCom MN opens in Podgorica. February 2000 — branch in Skopje. 2001 — acquires Bulgarian company Ekus.
visual: NTCHS logo over Sarajevo, TradeCom MN over Podgorica, Skopje panorama, Sofia panorama

title: First Retail Steps
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: the first pilot retail store in downtown Belgrade in 2001.
spoken: In two thousand one the first pilot store opened in downtown Belgrade, offering IT products directly to consumers for the first time.
detail: In 2001, the first pilot store opened downtown, offering IT products directly to consumers — the beginning of Comtrade's retail journey. The store was at TC Staklenac on Republic Square.
source_text: In 2001, the first pilot store opens downtown, offering IT products directly to consumers.
visual: TC Staklenac on Republic Square, archival photo

title: Spinnaker New Technologies Sets Sail
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: April 2001, Comtrade enters system integration via Spinnaker NT, which later becomes Comtrade System Integration.
spoken: In April two thousand one, Comtrade entered the world of system integration. The new business, headquartered in Dedinje, was named Spinnaker New Technologies — and it eventually became Comtrade System Integration. This was the start of a whole new business trajectory.
detail: April 2001 — Comtrade enters system integration. The new business was headquartered in Dedinje, Belgrade, and named Spinnaker New Technologies. It marked a shift beyond hardware toward IT services, and the company eventually renamed it Comtrade System Integration. By 2000 it was clear the market was ready for IT services and solutions, not just computers and equipment.
source_text: April 2001 — Comtrade enters the world of system integration. The new business gets a new name, headquartered in Dedinje, Belgrade. The company eventually changed its name to Comtrade System Integration.

title: CAN Advertising Is Founded
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: 2001, the in-house creative team becomes a full marketing agency, CAN Advertising.
spoken: Also in two thousand one, the in-house creative team grew into a full-service marketing agency — CAN Advertising — supporting all the companies of the Comtrade Group.
detail: In 2001, the in-house creative team became a full-service marketing agency, CAN Advertising, supporting Comtrade Group companies.
source_text: Also in 2001, the in-house creative team becomes a full-service marketing agency supporting Comtrade Group companies.

title: Belgrade Shipyard Site Acquired
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: December 2003, purchase of the building and land that became the largest IT campus in Southeast Europe.
spoken: In December two thousand three, Comtrade bought an eight-thousand-square-metre building and over three hectares of land — laying the foundation for what would become the largest IT campus in Southeast Europe.
detail: December 2003 — Comtrade purchased an 8,000 m² building along with 3.3 hectares of land, the foundation for the largest IT campus in Southeast Europe.
source_text: December 2003 — Comtrade purchases an 8,000 m² building along with 3.3 hectares of land, laying the foundation for what would become the largest IT campus in Southeast Europe.
visual: photos of the building during renovation, drawings by Misa Dimitrijevic

title: Retail on the Rise
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: March 2005, retail operations spun into a separate entity developing the Comtrade Shop franchise.
spoken: In March two thousand five, Comtrade separated its retail operations into a new entity and began developing the Comtrade Shop franchise.
detail: March 2005 — Comtrade separates its retail operations into a new entity, developing the Comtrade Shop franchise.
source_text: March 2005 — Comtrade separates its retail operations into a new entity, developing the Comtrade Shop franchise.
visual: photos from retail stores, Comtrade Shop logo

title: A New Headquarters — A Belgrade Landmark Opens
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: 2005, opening of Comtrade's New Belgrade headquarters, later a landmark; two design phases by two architects.
spoken: After two years of renovation, Comtrade's new headquarters opened in two thousand five — soon a symbol of modern Belgrade, spread across more than three hectares. The first design was by architect Milan Dimitrijevic; fifteen years later the whole complex was refreshed by architect Bojan Supeljak, giving the campus its contemporary look.
detail: After two years of renovation, Comtrade's new headquarters opened in 2005 on New Belgrade — the most modern technology center of its kind, over three hectares. The initial renovation was designed by architect Milan Dimitrijevic; fifteen years later the entire complex underwent a comprehensive facelift led by architect Bojan Supeljak.
source_text: After two years of renovation, Comtrade's new headquarters open in 2005 — soon to become a symbol of modern Belgrade. Initial renovation designed by Milan Dimitrijevic; fifteen years later a facelift led by Bojan Supeljak.
visual: collage of SN7 before and after opening

title: Launch of the Comtrade Computer Brand
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: 2005, Comtrade begins manufacturing its own PCs at scale.
spoken: In two thousand five, Comtrade began manufacturing its own personal computers on a high-capacity line producing up to thirty thousand units a month.
detail: 2005 — Comtrade begins manufacturing its own PCs on a high-capacity production line of 30,000 units per month, under the Comtrade Computer brand.
source_text: 2005 — Comtrade begins manufacturing its own PCs on a high-capacity production line of 30,000 units per month.
visual: production line photo, Comtrade Computer logo

title: Crypton Brand Launched
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: 2005, Comtrade enters consumer electronics with Crypton, a stepping stone to the later Tesla brand.
spoken: Also in two thousand five, Comtrade entered consumer electronics with the Crypton brand — a stepping stone toward the Tesla brand that would come later.
detail: In 2005 Comtrade entered consumer electronics with Crypton — a precursor to the Tesla brand.
source_text: Also in 2005, Comtrade enters consumer electronics — a stepping stone toward the Tesla brand to come.

title: Comtrade Holding Incorporated in Amsterdam
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: September 2005, ownership consolidation in Amsterdam, paving the way for international growth.
spoken: In September two thousand five, ownership was consolidated through Comtrade Holding in Amsterdam — paving the way for international growth.
detail: September 2005 — ownership consolidation begins via Comtrade Holding in Amsterdam, enabling international growth.
source_text: September 2005 — ownership consolidation begins, paving the way for international growth.

title: A New Home for CT Sarajevo
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: 2006, Comtrade Bosnia acquires its own office building.
spoken: In two thousand six, Comtrade Bosnia acquired its own three-thousand-square-metre office building in Sarajevo.
detail: 2006 — Comtrade Bosnia acquires its own 3,000 m² office building.
source_text: 2006 — Comtrade Bosnia acquires its own 3,000 m² office building.

title: Partnership with UniCredit Investment
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: 2008, UniCredit takes a stake in Comtrade to fund expansion.
spoken: In two thousand eight, Comtrade sold a twenty-one percent stake to UniCredit, securing funds for major expansion.
detail: 2008 — Comtrade sells a 21.05% stake to UniCredit, securing funds for major expansion. Working with banks was already a standard part of Comtrade's operations by then.
source_text: 2008 — Comtrade sells 21.05% stake to UniCredit, securing funds for major expansion.

title: Acquisition of Hermes SoftLab
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: 2008, the largest Serbian investment in Slovenia to date, creating a 1,600-strong software powerhouse.
spoken: In two thousand eight, Comtrade acquired Slovenia's Hermes SoftLab — the largest Serbian investment in Slovenia up to that point. The merger created a software powerhouse of sixteen hundred people and shifted the focus toward solutions.
detail: 2008 — Comtrade acquires Slovenia's Hermes SoftLab, a well-known software house that exported most of its services, in the largest Serbian investment in Slovenia to date. The result was a company of 1,600 employees active in system integration, IT distribution, consumer electronics, and software solutions. Soon after came the 2009 global financial crisis; the following year, when surviving banks were unable to support the economy, was the hardest in the company's history — but the group adapted, restructured, cut costs, and reversed the situation within two years.
source_text: 2008 — Comtrade acquires Slovenia's Hermes SoftLab, in the largest Serbian investment in Slovenia to date. The merger creates a 1,600-strong software powerhouse and shifts focus to solutions.

title: Three Pillars of Business
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: after the Hermes acquisition, Comtrade reorganizes into three business pillars.
spoken: After the Hermes acquisition, Comtrade reorganized around three pillars: distribution, IT solutions and services, and gaming.
detail: Following the Hermes acquisition, Comtrade reorganized into three areas: Distribution, IT Solutions & Services, and Gaming.
source_text: After the Hermes acquisition, Comtrade reorganizes into: Distribution, IT Solutions & Services, and Gaming.

title: Partners in Innovation — Keys to the Garage
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: HP recognizes Comtrade for 20 years of partnership with the Keys to the Garage award.
spoken: HP recognized Comtrade for twenty years of successful partnership with a symbolic award: the Keys to the Garage.
detail: HP recognized Comtrade for 20 years of successful partnership with the 'Keys to the Garage' award — a nod to HP's own garage origins.
source_text: HP recognizes Comtrade for 20 years of successful partnership. Keys to the Garage award.

title: Knowledge Is the Key — Knowledge Factory
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: 2011 education initiative Knowledge Factory reaching students across the region.
spoken: In two thousand eleven, the education initiative Knowledge Factory by Comtrade spread across the region — more than fifteen thousand pupils and students attended events in Belgrade, Podgorica, Zvornik, and Andricgrad.
detail: 2011 — the education initiative 'Knowledge Factory by Comtrade' spread throughout the region. More than 15,000 pupils and students attended events in Belgrade, Podgorica, Zvornik and Andricgrad.
source_text: 2011 — an education initiative, 'Knowledge Factory by Comtrade' spreads throughout the region. More than 15,000 pupils and students attended events in Belgrade, Podgorica, Zvornik and Andric grad.
visual: photos from Knowledge Factory in Podgorica, Zvornik, Belgrade

title: Entering the Global Gaming Market
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: Comtrade Gaming's breakthrough, from Bally's as first major client to a Philippines branch.
spoken: At the end of two thousand eleven came a breakthrough for Comtrade Gaming: Bally's became its first major client, with many renowned names soon to follow. In twenty fifteen, a new branch in the Philippines began supporting clients like Amatic, Dafabet, and Genting.
detail: End of 2011 — a breakthrough for Comtrade Gaming; Bally's becomes the first major client, with many renowned names to follow. Comtrade Gaming became one of the most successful firms in gaming-industry software. 2015 — a new branch in the Philippines supports major clients including Amatic, Dafabet and Genting.
source_text: End of 2011 — a breakthrough moment for Comtrade Gaming. Bally's becomes first major client. 2015 – New branch in the Philippines supports major clients including Amatic, Dafabet and Genting.
visual: Bally logo, Comtrade Gaming logo, ICE London photos, Manila building

title: Dual Focus — Two New Companies Emerge
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: March 2013, Comtrade IT Solutions and Services splits into Comtrade System Integration and Comtrade Digital Services.
spoken: In March two thousand thirteen, Comtrade IT Solutions and Services split into two companies: Comtrade System Integration and Comtrade Digital Services.
detail: March 2013 — Comtrade IT Solutions and Services splits into Comtrade System Integration (CSI) and Comtrade Digital Services (CDS).
source_text: March 2013 — Comtrade IT Solutions and Services splits into Comtrade System Integration and Comtrade Digital Services.
visual: CT ITSS logo > Comtrade SI logo + CDS logo

title: A Tribute to Innovation — The Tesla Brand Is Born
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: 2014, launch of the Tesla consumer-electronics brand inspired by Nikola Tesla, with the slogan Technology for all.
spoken: In two thousand fourteen, inspired by the legacy of Nikola Tesla, Comtrade launched its own consumer-electronics brand. Guided by the vision technology for all, Tesla began with tablets and phones and grew to TVs and air conditioners. Today it offers over six hundred products across forty-five markets worldwide.
detail: 2014 — inspired by Nikola Tesla, Comtrade launched the Tesla consumer-electronics brand. Guided by the vision 'Technology for all,' it began with tablets, mobile phones, TVs and air conditioners, and today offers over 600 products across 45 markets worldwide. The slogan reflects Tesla's idea that technology should benefit everyone, not a privileged few.
source_text: 2014 — Comtrade launched its own consumer electronics brand. Guided by the vision 'Technology for all', the Tesla brand started with tablets, mobile phones, TVs and air conditioners. Today it offers over 600 products across 45 markets worldwide.
visual: screen with Tesla product video clips

title: Comtrade Partners with CERN
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: 2015, Comtrade joins CERN openlab, contributing data-management solutions for the Large Hadron Collider.
spoken: In two thousand fifteen, Comtrade joined CERN openlab, contributing to data-management solutions for the world's largest scientific project — the Large Hadron Collider. The partner lineup included Oracle, Siemens, and NVIDIA. Comtrade was responsible for EOS, the system that handles the petabytes of data the collider generates.
detail: 2015 — Comtrade joined CERN openlab, contributing to data-management solutions for the Large Hadron Collider, alongside partners such as Oracle, Siemens, Intel and NVIDIA. Comtrade was responsible for EOS, the data processing and distribution system that manages the petabytes of data generated by CERN's Large Hadron Collider.
source_text: In 2015, Comtrade joined CERN openlab, contributing to the development of data management solutions for the Large Hadron Collider. Partners such as Oracle, Siemens, and NVIDIA actively participating.

title: Innovation Pays Off — Citrix Acquires Comtrade IP
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: January 2016, Comtrade sells management-pack IP to Citrix, its first asset sale.
spoken: In January two thousand sixteen, Comtrade sold its management-pack intellectual property to Citrix — the company's first asset sale.
detail: January 2016 — Comtrade sells management pack IP to Citrix, its first asset sale.
source_text: January 2016 — Comtrade sells management pack IP to Citrix, its first asset sale.

title: Growing Presence — Distribution Expands Across Europe
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: 2016–2018, Comtrade Distribution expands to 14 countries covering 75 million people.
spoken: Between two thousand sixteen and two thousand eighteen, Comtrade Distribution opened new offices across Europe. By the end of the expansion it was present in fourteen countries reaching seventy-five million people.
detail: 2016–2018 — Comtrade Distribution's new offices open in Slovenia, Croatia, Hungary, Bulgaria, Romania, and Greece. After the 2018 expansion, Comtrade Distribution is present in Serbia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Croatia, Slovenia, Romania, Greece, Bulgaria, Hungary, Moldova, Cyprus, Albania and Malta — 14 countries, 75 million people.
source_text: 2016–2018 — Comtrade Distribution's new offices open in Slovenia, Croatia, Hungary, Bulgaria, Romania, and Greece. 14 countries. 75 million people.

title: Reinvention — HYCU Is Born
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: 2018, Comtrade Software rebrands as HYCU, entering a new growth phase.
spoken: In two thousand eighteen, Comtrade Software rebranded as HYCU, entering a new growth phase.
detail: 2018 — Comtrade Software rebrands as HYCU, entering a new growth phase. HYCU was later acquired by Bain Capital.
source_text: 2018 — Comtrade Software rebrands as HYCU, entering a new growth phase.

title: Regional Data Center Opens in Belgrade
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: 2018, the largest data center in Southeast Europe begins operation, located at the Belgrade campus.
spoken: In two thousand eighteen, the largest data center in Southeast Europe began operation, here at the Belgrade campus.
detail: 2018 — the largest data center in Southeast Europe begins operation, located at SN7, the Belgrade headquarters.
source_text: 2018 — the largest data center in Southeast Europe begins operation.
visual: photos of the data center at SN7

title: Strategic Transactions
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: two landmark transactions — Endava acquires Comtrade Digital Services (2020) and Bain Capital acquires HYCU (2021).
spoken: Two landmark deals mark this period. In August two thousand twenty, Endava acquired Comtrade Digital Services. In March two thousand twenty-one, Bain Capital acquired HYCU.
detail: August 2020 — Endava acquires Comtrade Digital Services. March 2021 — Bain Capital acquires HYCU.
source_text: Endava acquires Comtrade Digital Services — August 2020. Bain Capital acquires HYCU — March 2021.

title: Comtrade 360 Launched
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: 2021, launch of Comtrade 360 for modern software engineering, headquartered in Ljubljana with offices in Serbia.
spoken: In two thousand twenty-one, a new company was born to meet modern software-engineering needs: Comtrade 360. Headquartered in Ljubljana, with offices in Belgrade, Novi Sad, and Kragujevac, it specializes in software services, AI and machine-learning solutions, and Salesforce.
detail: 2021 — Comtrade 360 is founded to address modern needs in software engineering and development. Headquartered in Ljubljana with offices in Belgrade, Novi Sad and Kragujevac, it specializes in software services, AI/ML solutions, and Salesforce solutions.
source_text: 2021 — Comtrade360 specializes in software services, AI / ML solutions as well as Salesforce solutions. Headquartered in Ljubljana with offices in Belgrade, Novi Sad and Kragujevac.
visual: Comtrade 360 logo, offices in Novi Sad and Ljubljana

title: Record Year — Half a Billion in Revenue
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: 2022, Comtrade Group reaches 500 million euros in revenue for the first time.
spoken: In two thousand twenty-two, the Comtrade Group reached five hundred million euros in revenue for the first time.
detail: 2022 — Comtrade Group reaches EUR 500 million in revenue for the first time.
source_text: 2022 — Comtrade Group reaches EUR 500 million for the first time.

title: A New Chapter — Headquarters Move to Switzerland
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: June 2024, headquarters move to Switzerland, marking a new era of global presence.
spoken: In June two thousand twenty-four, the headquarters moved to Switzerland — marking a new era of global presence.
detail: June 2024 — headquarters move to Switzerland, marking a new era of global presence. Today Comtrade has over 3,000 employees, more than half of them software engineers, with centers in Belgrade, Boston, Dublin, Manila and Ljubljana, and companies across the Adriatic region, Greece, Hungary, Bulgaria, Romania and Malta — three continents, seventeen countries.
source_text: June 2024 — marking a new era of global presence. Headquarters move to Switzerland.

title: Tesla Milestone — One Million TVs Sold
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: 2025, the Tesla brand passes one million TVs sold, symbolizing how far the vision has come.
spoken: In two thousand twenty-five, the Tesla brand passed a milestone of one million TVs sold — a symbol of how far the original vision has come.
detail: 2025 — one million Tesla TVs sold, a symbol of how far the vision of 'technology for all' has come.
source_text: 2025 — a symbol of how far the vision has come. 1 million TVs sold.

title: Supporting the Queen of Sports
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: Comtrade's and the founder's long-standing support for athletics, including the Serbian Athletics Federation and the Belgrade Marathon.
spoken: From its founding, Comtrade has supported sports, and athletics has always held a special place. A former athlete himself, Mr. Jevrosimovic served as President of the Serbian Athletics Federation for fourteen years — its most successful era, from building the Belgrade Athletics Hall to a remarkable medal tally. Comtrade was also general sponsor of the Belgrade Marathon in twenty twenty-four and twenty twenty-five, its highest-participation years.
detail: Since its founding Comtrade has actively supported sports, with athletics — the 'queen of sports' — holding a special place. As a former athlete, Mr. Jevrosimovic served as President of the Serbian Athletics Federation for 14 years, the most successful tenure in its history: from the construction of the Belgrade Athletics Hall, through top-level international competitions, to an impressive medal tally. Comtrade was general sponsor of the Belgrade Marathon for two consecutive years; the 2024 and 2025 editions had the highest participation in the marathon's history.
source_text: Mr. Jevrosimovic took on the role of President of the Serbian Athletics Federation, a position he held for 14 years. Comtrade served as the general sponsor of the Belgrade Marathon for two consecutive years. The 2024 and 2025 editions marked the highest participation in the marathon's history.
visual: photos from the marathon and the European Athletics Championship

title: Comtrade SI — Achievements Over the Years
context_prefix: Hall of Fame panel: Comtrade System Integration's awards — Microsoft Partner of the Year, MSSP Alert cybersecurity ranking, and a social-responsibility award.
spoken: Comtrade System Integration has been named Microsoft Partner of the Year in seven of ten consecutive years. In twenty twenty-five it ranked seventy-fifth on the MSSP Alert Global Top 250 in cybersecurity, up from one hundred forty-nine the year before. It also received the Djordje Vajfert Award for social responsibility in twenty twenty-three.
detail: Microsoft Partner of the Year — awarded in 7 of 10 consecutive years: 2015 (Serbia), 2017 (Serbia), 2019 (Serbia), 2020 (Serbia), 2023 (Bosnia and Herzegovina), 2024 (Slovenia), 2025 (Serbia). Cybersecurity — in 2025, Comtrade System Integration ranked 75th on the MSSP Alert Global Top 250 list, rising from 149th in 2024; the list recognizes leading Managed Security Service Providers. Social responsibility — recipient of the Djordje Vajfert Award for Social Responsibility in Business, presented by the Serbian Chamber of Commerce in 2023.
source_text: Microsoft Partner of the Year: 7 out of 10 consecutive years. In 2025, Comtrade System Integration ranked 75th on the MSSP Alert Global Top 250 list, rising from #149 in 2024. Recipient of the Djordje Vajfert Award for Social Responsibility, 2023.

context_prefix: Story-mode narrative on Comtrade's 1991 founding and the world context of that moment. Use for guided storytelling and follow-ups, not tied to a single plaque.
spoken: Our story begins in nineteen ninety-one, a year the world was changing fast. Apartheid was ending in South Africa, the Soviet Union was dissolving, and the former Yugoslavia was sliding into conflict. In Belgrade, despite the tensions, a young entrepreneur named Veselin Jevrosimovic decided to start a computer business. He was already a partner in CHS Electronics, then one of the world's largest computer-equipment distributors. He named his company from the English words computer and trade, Comtrad. And so it began.
detail: In 1991 apartheid ended in South Africa, the Soviet Union dissolved after Gorbachev's resignation, and the Yugoslav republics began the conflicts that would collapse the shared state. In Belgrade, Veselin Jevrosimovic chose to start a computer business despite the tensions. He already had a successful career, owning a company in Germany and holding a partnership in CHS Electronics, which at its peak had annual revenue of 12 billion dollars. The first offices were in apartment A303, later also B39, in the prestigious Genex apartments in New Belgrade, which remained Comtrade's home for its first ten years.
source_text: PC Press monograph v3 (translated to English).
source: Teks za monografiju PC Press v3.docx

context_prefix: Story-mode narrative on regional expansion in the late 1990s.
spoken: As the business grew, it became clear that staying tied to Belgrade alone would not be enough. In nineteen ninety-eight the first company abroad opened in Sarajevo, followed by Montenegro, North Macedonia, and Bulgaria. That regional presence rebuilt business ties that politics and conflict had broken.
detail: The company was growing and the IT market was expanding, but it became clear that widening the product range would not deliver results if the business stayed tied to Belgrade. So in 1998 the first company abroad opened in Sarajevo, followed by Montenegro, North Macedonia, and Bulgaria. Regional presence strengthened the distribution business and, while conflicts in the former shared state were still ongoing, rebuilt ties that politics had severed.
source_text: PC Press monograph v3 (translated to English).
source: Teks za monografiju PC Press v3.docx

context_prefix: Story-mode narrative on the shift to IT services and the move into the new technology center.
spoken: By the early two-thousands the market was ready for the next step, not just computers, but IT services. So in two thousand one the company Spinnaker was founded, which would later become Comtrade System Integration. And in two thousand five, Comtrade moved into its new home in New Belgrade, the most modern technology center of its kind, spread across more than three hectares.
detail: By 2000 it was evident the market was ready for the next step: not only computers and equipment, but IT services. In 2001 Spinnaker was founded, later renamed Comtrade System Integration to formally mark its domain, system integration. In 2005 Comtrade moved into its new home in New Belgrade, the most modern technology center of its kind, spanning more than three hectares.
source_text: PC Press monograph v3 (translated to English).
source: Teks za monografiju PC Press v3.docx

context_prefix: Story-mode narrative on the Hermes SoftLab acquisition, the 2009 global crisis, and the recovery.
spoken: In two thousand eight, Comtrade made the largest investment by a Serbian company in Slovenia, buying Hermes SoftLab and creating a company of sixteen hundred employees. Then came two thousand nine and the global financial crisis. The following year was the hardest in the company's history, but the group adapted, restructured, and within two years had completely turned the situation around.
detail: In 2008 Comtrade made the largest investment by a Serbian company in the Slovenian market: it bought Hermes SoftLab, a software house that exported most of its services. The result was a company of 1,600 employees active in system integration, IT distribution, consumer electronics, and software solutions. Then in 2009 the global economic crisis hit; the next year, when surviving banks were unwilling to support the economy, was the hardest in the company's history. But the group's member firms adapted to the new conditions, restructured, cut costs, and two years later the situation had fully reversed.
source_text: PC Press monograph v3 (translated to English).
source: Teks za monografiju PC Press v3.docx

context_prefix: Story-mode narrative on the growth of standalone businesses: Digital Services, Software/HYCU, and Gaming.
spoken: The company entered the second decade of the century with several fully developed standalone businesses. Alongside distribution and system integration came Comtrade Digital Services, later sold to Endava; Comtrade Software, later renamed HYCU and sold to Bain Capital; and Comtrade Gaming, one of the most successful firms in gaming-industry software. Veselin Jevrosimovic understood that standing still means falling behind, so he kept moving forward.
detail: Comtrade entered the 2010s with several developed standalone businesses: besides distribution and system integration, it formed Comtrade Digital Services (later sold to Endava), Comtrade Software (later renamed HYCU and sold to Bain Capital), and Comtrade Gaming. As an experienced businessman, Jevrosimovic understood that businesses which do not develop, decline, so he pressed on.
source_text: PC Press monograph v3 (translated to English).
